name: Meteor Palm
description: Drop a palm on the foe from above with a hard point of starlight at the heel of the hand.

name: Meteor Ward
description: Throw up a short bright shell of qi overhead and in front that burns off the force of a blow.

name: Meteor Step
description: Drop low and shoot forward in a streak of qi so the distance closes before the foe sets.

name: Shard Touch
description: Touch the foe's wrist with a shard of starlit qi that breaks the rhythm of the strike.

name: Fall Sense
description: Feel the qi above and about you for any blow falling from a height and mark where it will land.

name: Meteoric Blow
description: Bring the whole weight of the body down in one blow wrapped in a burning wake of starlit qi.

name: Shard Rain
description: Fling a spray of starlit shards outward that rains on every foe within a short reach.

name: Pulsar Fist
description: Throw a punch that carries a single beat of starlight timed to land with the foe's breath out.

name: Pulse Ward
description: Pulse a thin shell of qi in time with the foe's blows so each one meets it at full strength.

name: Throb Step
description: Step on the beat of the qi and change pace on the next beat so the foe cannot keep time.

name: Beat Turn
description: Turn a blow aside on the beat of the qi and answer it on the next with the open hand.

name: Beating Pulse
description: Set a pulse of starlit qi beating in the foe's arm out of time with his own so the limb jerks and drops its guard.

name: Pulse Surge
description: Send a pulse of starlight through an ally's limbs to lend swiftness and strength for several breaths.

name: Zenith Fist
description: Throw a high punch from the full height of the reach with the starlit qi gathered at the knuckles.

name: Nadir Kick
description: Sweep a low kick at the shin with a point of qi driven at the lowest part of the stance.

name: Zenith Ward
description: Raise both forearms to the highest point above the head and cover the upper line with starlit qi.

name: Nadir Step
description: Sink to the lowest point of the stance and surge forward along the ground under the foe's reach.

name: Zenith Turn
description: Lift the guard hand to its highest point and roll a blow off the top of the forearm.

name: Nadir Reading
description: Send the qi down to the ground and feel the weight of every foot that stands within a few paces.

name: Rising Zenith
description: Drive a rising point of starlight up from below the guard to the underside of the chin.

name: Nadir Press
description: Press the foe's qi down to its lowest point so the legs sag and the stance sinks into the ground.

name: Corona Fist
description: Close the fist in a bright rim of qi and strike so a burning edge follows the blow.

name: Corona Ward
description: Hold a thin ring of bright qi about the forearms so a blow is checked at its rim.

name: Corona Step
description: Circle the foe at arm's length with the ring of qi held out so the foe cannot close in.

name: Rim Turn
description: Catch a strike on the rim of the bright ring and spin it off to the side.

name: Corona Shield
description: Spread the ring of starlight into a full shell about the body that takes a hard blow without breaking.

name: Corona Flare
description: Flare the ring outward in one bright flash that dazzles every eye near and spoils the aim.

name: Pattern Fist
description: Strike along one line of a pattern of points so the blow follows the line through the body.

name: Pattern Ward
description: Set three points of qi round the body in a small pattern that shares a blow among them.

name: Pattern Step
description: Step along the lines of a pattern laid on the ground and cross the gap by the shortest line.

name: Chart Reading
description: Chart the points of qi in the foe's body and read from them which limb will move first.

name: Chart Mend
description: Trace the line of an injury with starlit qi and press the points to ease it in yourself or an ally.

name: Pattern Turn
description: Turn a blow along the nearest line of the pattern and let it run out past the body.

name: Linked Stars
description: Join three points of starlight along the foe's body and drive the qi through all of them in one thrust.

name: Starry Cover
description: Spread a field of small stars over an ally and yourself that thins a blow to a scatter of sparks.

name: Starlit Cleanse
description: Pour a slow wash of starlight through a poisoned or fevered body and carry the taint out of yourself or an ally.
